EU AI Act — Risk Classification Tiers
Social scoring, mass surveillance, emotion recognition in workplaces — BANNED
Medical devices, biometric ID, critical infrastructure, autonomous vehicles
Hiring, credit scoring, judicial systems → Mandatory conformity assessment
Requirements: logging, transparency, human oversight, robustness
Chatbots, deepfakes → Transparency obligations (must disclose AI use)
Spam filters, AI in games, recommendation engines → Voluntary codes of conduct
FAIR Model for AI Risk Quantification
Loss Exposure = Threat Event Freq × Vulnerability × Loss Magnitude
Quantitative: Monte Carlo simulation → annual loss expectancy (ALE) in $
